time_window: 2022 composite; survey-year field exposed by official layer metadata
measurement_method: Environment Agency ArcGIS REST FeatureServer layer-3 metadata
spatial_binding_method: Official EPSG:27700 layer extent transformed to EPSG:4326 Polygon; source-area only

field_evidence.source_description: First Return DSM extents index showing survey coverage and attributes including survey date, resolution and unique survey reference.

limitations: This package is source-area coverage evidence only, not repository canonical parcel acceptance.
No building-footprint/canonical-parcel spatial join is established.
No official DEM/LIDAR min/max/mean/max-min statistics were computed for a building-containing canonical parcel.
